contentBlocks.body: Type a list of numbers as number[] and a list of strings as string[]. For a lookup object keyed by string, use Record<string, number>. These annotations let the compiler check every element and value.

contentBlocks.code:
const scores: number[] = [80, 92];
const counts: Record<string, number> = { a: 2, b: 1 };

knowledgeItems.prompt: Which type describes an array of strings?

payload.explanation: Append [] to the element type: string[] is an array of strings.

payload.text: An object used as a string-keyed lookup of numbers can be typed as ____<string, number>.
